config.moemusic.title: MoeMusic Settings
config.moemusic.save_conflict.title: Some Settings Were Not Saved
config.moemusic.save_conflict.body: MoeMusic settings changed elsewhere while this screen was open. Conflicting changes were discarded; reopen the settings screen and try again.
config.moemusic.client_only_notice: §eNote: settings in this screen are saved on this client and do not change server settings.
When off, this client will not play MoeMusic tracks or join vote and playback interactions, but search and song requests still work.
config.moemusic.client.current_server_pl: Allow MoeMusic to play tracks while connected to %1$s. Enable Local Playback must also be on.
config.moemusic.client.current_server.un: Join a server or open a world before changing per-server settings.
config.moemusic.client.block_vanilla_mus: Block built-in background music while MoeMusic is playing a track.
config.moemusic.client.block_records.too: Block jukebox sounds while MoeMusic is playing a track. Note blocks are not affected.
config.moemusic.client.global_instance_p: Only one Minecraft instance on this device may play tracks at a time. Other instances enter standby until the active instance stops playback or exits the game.
config.moemusic.client.loudness_normaliz: Choose whether MoeMusic disables normalization, only attenuates loud tracks, or allows conservative boosts when the source also provides valid peak data.
Target integrated loudness used for normalization. Lower values keep more headroom and reduce how often conservative boost can engage.
Enter a finite LUFS target between %1$s and %2$s.
config.moemusic.default_source_id.toolti:
Used as the default source for search and preferred when adding songs from links or IDs. Leave blank to choose automatically.
§eBefore changing this, join any single-player world once so MoeMusic can load available sources.
config.moemusic.default_language.tooltip: Language used when the player's preferred language can't be determined or isn't supported by the server. This doesn't affect the language used for client-side features like the Now Playing HUD.
config.moemusic.autoplay.enabled.tooltip: When enabled, MoeMusic fetches tracks from all registered sources and plays them automatically in random order when no player has requested a song.
config.moemusic.autoplay.max_tracks_per_: Maximum tracks each source may provide when Autoplay is refreshed. Extra tracks are ignored.
config.moemusic.permissions.description: When no third-party permission mod is installed, MoeMusic uses Minecraft's built-in permission levels. Singleplayer hosts are allowed for levels 0-4. If you use a permission mod, configure MoeMusic permissions there.
config.moemusic.permissions.level.toolti: Permission level required for this action. Set to 0 for anyone, 1-4 for vanilla permission levels (4 is OP), or 5 to disable for all players (you can still grant it via permission mod or use console commands).
config.moemusic.vote_required_percent.to: Percentage of votes required to pass a skip vote, rounded up. Set to 51 to keep a simple majority rule.
Show song info, cover art, lyrics, and related playback details in-game while a track is playing.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.anchor.t: Screen position used to anchor the HUD.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.offset_x: Horizontal distance from the screen edge.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.offset_y: Vertical distance from the screen edge.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.vertical: HUD height. Also affects cover size and text layout.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.text_max: Maximum width available to titles, song info, and lyric lines.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.cover_si: Whether the cover appears to the left or right of the text.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.progress: Whether the progress bar appears above or below the main HUD content.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.show_bac: Draw a background behind HUD text and cover art to improve readability.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.show_cov: Show track cover art on the HUD.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.show_tit: Show the track title on the HUD.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.show_art: Show the artist on the HUD.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.show_alb: Show the album on the HUD.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.show_tim: Show elapsed time and total duration on the HUD.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.show_pro: Draw the progress bar on the HUD.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.show_lyr: Show lyrics on the HUD when the source provides them. Only the current line is shown.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.circular: Crop the cover art into a circle.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.show_cen: Draw a record-style center dot on circular covers.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.spin_cov: Spin the cover while playing. Only applies when circular cover mode is enabled.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.text_col: Primary text color as 8 hex digits in ARGB format, for example FFFFFFFF.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.secondar: Secondary text color in ARGB format.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.backgrou: Background color as 8 hex digits in ARGB format. Alpha controls transparency.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.progress: Progress bar color while playing, in ARGB format.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.paused_p: Progress bar color while paused, in ARGB format.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.progress: Progress bar background color in ARGB format.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.record_r: Outer ring color for circular covers.
config.moemusic.now_playing_hud.argb.inv: Expected 8 hex digits in ARGB format.
config.moemusic.plugin.no_settings: This plugin has no configurable settings.

screen.moemusic.config.unavailable.body: MoeMusic settings require Cloth Config. Install Cloth Config on this client, restart Minecraft, and reopen the settings screen.
screen.moemusic.unavailable.title: MoeMusic Not Installed on Server
screen.moemusic.unavailable.body: The current server did not respond to MoeMusic. Install MoeMusic on the server, then reconnect before opening the music player.
screen.moemusic.unavailable.rejected.bod: The server rejected the MoeMusic connection. Check that the client and server mods are compatible, then reconnect.
screen.moemusic.unavailable.rejected.ser: The server rejected the MoeMusic connection because of a server-side error. Ask the server administrator to check the MoeMusic server logs, then reconnect.
screen.moemusic.unavailable.protocol_mis: The server uses MoeMusic protocol %2$s, but this client uses protocol %1$s. Update the client-side MoeMusic mod, then reconnect.
This client uses MoeMusic protocol %1$s, but the server uses protocol %2$s. Ask the server administrator to update MoeMusic on the server, then reconnect.
Both sides reported MoeMusic protocol %1$s, but the handshake was still rejected. Reinstall or update MoeMusic on both sides, then reconnect.
screen.moemusic.unavailable.compatibilit: Connected in compatibility mode with legacy protocol v%1$s. Advanced transport features like compression and chunking are disabled.

tip.moemusic.open_gui.body: Press %1$s to open the music player. You can change this keybind in Minecraft's Controls settings.
config.moemusic.content_filter.enabled.t: Controls all content filtering. When off, content filter checks are not performed.
config.moemusic.content_filter.scope_not: §eRules here are saved locally and are not synced to remote servers. In single-player worlds, they also apply to the built-in server. On third-party servers, they only apply through your local filter.
config.moemusic.client.content_filter.en: Enable the local filter on third-party servers. When enabled, this client hides blocked search results, playlist entries, and currently playing tracks according to local rules.
config.moemusic.client.content_filter.se: How this client should show search results that match local filter rules.
config.moemusic.client.content_filter.qu: How this client should show playlist tracks that match local filter rules.
config.moemusic.content_filter.exact_tra: Block rules for specific tracks. Only match the specified track ID from the specified source.
config.moemusic.content_filter.exact_art: Block rules for specific artists. Only match the specified artist ID from the specified source, or the artist name when a stable ID is unavailable.
config.moemusic.content_filter.text_rule: Text or regex block rules. You can choose the match scope (search query, title, artist, album, extra text, or all text fields) and whether case should be ignored.
config.moemusic.content_filter.rule.sour: Fill Source ID before saving this rule.
config.moemusic.content_filter.rule.trac: Fill Track ID before saving this rule.
config.moemusic.content_filter.rule.arti: Fill Artist ID before saving this rule.
config.moemusic.content_filter.rule.patt: Fill Match Text before saving this text rule.
config.moemusic.media.cover_art.max_down: Maximum cover image download size. Very large images can affect game performance and stability.
config.moemusic.media.cover_art.max_sour: Cancel loading when a cover image's width or height exceeds this value. Very large images can affect game performance and stability.
Cancel loading when a cover image's width x height exceeds this value. Very large images can affect game performance and stability.
config.moemusic.media.cover_art.max_deco: Largest downscale factor allowed during decode. The actual value is calculated from source size and targets about 2x the final texture size, then limited by this setting.
config.moemusic.media.cover_art.max_text: Texture size uploaded to Minecraft after crop and resize. Decode first downsamples near 2x this size, then performs final resizing. Larger textures can improve quality but use more resources.
config.moemusic.media.rate_limit.enabled: Apply lightweight per-player rate limits before sending requests to music sources.
config.moemusic.media.rate_limit.window_: Sliding time window shared by search and song requests.
config.moemusic.media.rate_limit.search_: Maximum search requests each player may send in each window. Set to 0 to disable this limit.
config.moemusic.media.rate_limit.submit_: Maximum song requests each player may send in each window. Set to 0 to disable this limit.
config.moemusic.media.max_player_track_d: Reject tracks longer than this value. Tracks with unknown duration are also rejected unless the submitter has bypass permission.
config.moemusic.media.max_search_results: Maximum results the server returns for each search. Large values can affect performance or trigger source-side rate controls. This does not change the client display limit.
config.moemusic.media.media_firewall.ena: When enabled, MoeMusic blocks unsafe media links using the rules below, helping prevent the server or client from accessing private or forbidden addresses.
config.moemusic.media.media_firewall.hos: Choose blacklist or whitelist mode. In blacklist mode, listed targets are blocked. In whitelist mode, only listed targets are allowed.
One domain or IP address per line. `example.com` matches example.com and all of its subdomains. When the firewall is enabled, these targets are handled according to the selected list mode.
config.moemusic.media.media_firewall.blo: Resolve link targets and block private, loopback, and link-local addresses to avoid accessing private-network media.
config.moemusic.media.media_firewall.all:
Allow local file URLs using the `file://` protocol.
§eThis is usually not recommended unless you need a source plugin that points to local files.
